This is PvME's '''normal-mode mechanics guide''' for [[Amascut, the Devourer]]. The source was written early and partly from duo footage. Numbers may vary by team size, and some details may be mistaken.

[[File:Amascut, the Devourer.png|thumb|220px|alt=Amascut, the Devourer, in her boss encounter.|Amascut, the Devourer.]]

* '''Learning the fight?''' Start with [[#Phases|the five-phase overview]].
* '''Checking a call?''' Jump to [[#Triple Tap|Triple Tap]] or [[#Empowered Eruption|Empowered Eruption]].
* '''Watching a kill?''' Open the [[#Example kill|duo talkthrough]].

{{ToC|limit=3}}

== Normal-mode stats ==
* 4,000,000 life points; 3 × 3 size; 95 Defence and 2,765 armour rating; 55 affinity to all styles.
* Amascut is immune to poison and stuns. Most mobs are not. Amascut is not a Slayer creature.

== Mechanics ==
=== Auto-attacks ===
* Left hand: magic attack on all players.
* Right hand: melee area attack on the tank, ricocheting as ranged attacks on the other players within 10 tiles.
* Three rapid melee or magic swipes on the tank, in the style of the previous auto-attack.
** The following autos depend on the tank's protection or deflect prayer on the first hit. If that hit was prayed against incorrectly, the subsequent autos are the same style as the swipe.
* After three autos, Amascut starts a new mechanic at 100% adrenaline.

=== Mobs ===
{| class="wikitable"
! Mob !! Life points !! What it does
|-
| Gatekeeper gorilla akh || 45,000 || Kill to unlock the gateways. Can be stunned and bound.
|-
| Feline akh || 7,500 || Targets players carrying a fragment of Tumeken. Can be stunned and bound.
|-
| Volatile scarab || 2,000 || Stun to make it vulnerable. Explodes if left alone. Standing within one tile of its burrowing spot prevents it spawning.
|-
| Modest Crocodile || 15,000 || Has Modesty. At full adrenaline it uses a magic attack that removes 20% adrenaline and applies a 50% adrenaline-gain reduction to its target.
|-
| Chainwarden mage akh || 30,000 || Protects the three 15,000-LP chains beyond a gateway.
|-
| Explosive scarab || 5,000 || Kill and throw it to remove Carapace; the killed scarab expires over time.
|-
| Lightstealer salawa akh || 15,000 || Targets Tumeken's fragments and drains charge or reform progress. Can be stunned and bound.
|}

=== Buffs and debuffs ===
; Corruption
: The tank gains a stack per hit, increasing damage taken. Soulfire waves and shockwaves also add stacks. Maximum 15; stacks expire about 15 seconds after the last one.
; Apmeken's Burden
: Applied early in phase 2. Deals progressively more damage and adds a stack every 1.8 seconds. Pass it to a teammate before 8 stacks, which is an instant kill.
; Modesty
: Reflects non-basic attacks, including thresholds, ultimates, adrenaline-costing Necromancy abilities, [[Weapon Special Attack|weapon specials]], [[Volley of Souls]], and extra hits from [[Bow of the Last Guardian]] and [[Fractured Staff of Armadyl]]. Basic abilities, auto-attacks, conjure damage, Aftershock 4, Crackling 4, and poison are not reflected.
; Healing through Strength
: Mobs can have this in phase 4. Their damage heals Amascut for about 30% of that damage.
; Carapace
: Affected mobs are immune to damage until you throw an explosive scarab at them in phase 4.
; Interceptor
: Gained after blocking Amascut's Altar Strike once in phase 5. A second strike is an instant kill.

== Phases ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Phase !! Amascut life points at start !! Main job
|-
| [[#Phase 1|1]] || 4,000,000 || Read Triple Tap and Empowered Eruption.
|-
| [[#Phase 2|2]] || 2,800,000 || Free Apmeken and Crondis.
|-
| [[#Phase 3|3]] || 2,000,000 || Repeat the phase-one mechanics in a different order.
|-
| [[#Phase 4|4]] || 1,200,000 || Use scarabs to remove Carapace and free Het and Scabaras.
|-
| [[#Phase 5|5]] || 600,000 || Charge fragments and protect Tumeken.
|}

=== Phase 1 ===
'''Sequence:''' 3 magic autos → Triple Tap → swipes → 2 autos → Summon Scarabs → 1 auto → swipes → 1 auto → Crushing Soul → 2 autos → swipes → Empowered Eruption → 3 autos → Triple Tap → swipes → 2 autos → phase 2.

==== Triple Tap ====
Amascut launches three projectiles at the tank, two ticks apart. Green is ranged, blue is magic, red is melee.
{| class="wikitable"
! Voice cue !! Hit order
|-
| {{RSChat|Grovel}} || Magic → Melee → Ranged
|-
| {{RSChat|Pathetic}} || Melee → Ranged → Magic
|-
| {{RSChat|Weak}} || Ranged → Magic → Melee
|}

==== Summon Scarabs ====
On {{RSChat|Tear them apart}}, Amascut summons volatile scarab akhs. Stun them to make them vulnerable. If left alive, they explode for typeless damage.

==== Crushing Soul ====
On {{RSChat|Bend the knee}}, the tank takes heavy typeless damage with defensive penetration. Nearby teammates can share it in a 3 × 3 area around the tank. A DPS player can [[Provoke]] the hit while the group shares it, then the base tank can Provoke back.

==== Empowered Eruption ====
The arena changes colour and each player takes three hits of the indicated style.
{| class="wikitable"
! Voice cue !! Style
|-
| {{RSChat|Your soul is weak}} || Magic (blue)
|-
| {{RSChat|All strength withers}} || Melee (red)
|-
| {{RSChat|I will not suffer this}} || Ranged (green)
|}

==== Empowered auto and tank pull ====
* On the tick of the third rapid auto, Amascut hits the tank with a different style from the first three.
* If the player with aggro is too far away, Amascut says {{RSChat|You dare to turn your back on me?}} and drags them in, stunning and binding for 3 seconds. This grants her adrenaline and may replace an auto-attack.

=== Phase 2 ===
# A 200-second destruction timer starts. It kills the whole team if it expires.
# Kill both gatekeeper gorilla akhs. One player receives a ramping bleed that can be passed to an adjacent teammate, resetting the damage. Modest crocodiles spawn at the north entrances; use basic attacks to avoid the reflect. Feline akhs spawn as time goes on.
# Enter the west and east gateways to free Apmeken and Crondis. Inside each are a 30,000-LP chainwarden and three 15,000-LP chains.
# Each broken chain turns its corresponding statue yellow. A player in the main arena must cleanse it to make the break permanent. Clicking early causes damage; failing to cleanse within about 12 seconds allows the chain to respawn.
# Once all three chains in a gateway are broken and cleansed, the player inside can free the god and receive a fragment of Tumeken with a 30-second timer. Crondis's blessing spawns two more modest crocodile demons.
# Deliver the blessing to the correct statue to stun Amascut for 25 seconds. Surge and Dive cannot be used for this; [[Prism of Salvation]] and Barge work. The two stuns stack. When they end, phase 3 starts.

=== Phase 3 ===
Uses the same mechanics as phase 1. '''Sequence:''' 33% adrenaline, no auto → swipes → auto → Triple Tap → 2 autos → swipes → Summon Scarabs → 3 same autos → Crushing Soul → swipes → 2 autos → Empowered Eruption → auto → swipes → auto → Triple Tap → 2 autos → swipes → phase 4.

=== Phase 4 ===
* Enter the west and east gateways to free Het and Scabaras. Modest crocodiles do not spawn here.
* Non-scarab NPCs have Carapace. Kill and pick up explosive scarabs, then throw them at the guarded NPCs, including through the gateways. Weaken and kill the gorillas. Each gateway needs four scarabs: one for the chainwarden and one per chain.
* Scarab throwing has unlimited range. Living scarabs heal Amascut for 100 life points per scarab per 1.2 seconds. Exploding scarabs deal minor typeless damage to the whole team.

=== Phase 5 ===
==== Charging a fragment ====
On “Tumekens heart. Delivered to me by these mortals,” four fragments shoot from each statue, and Tumeken appears in the centre. Soul obelisks spawn west and east. Keep both below full health or they damage the entire team.

Channel energy from a statue to a fragment with one or more players, then have another player stand on the green line to intercept the attack. Swap interceptors: taking two hits in a row is an instant kill. Lightstealer salawa akhs spawn from the stairs and drain fragment charge if they get through.

==== Protecting Tumeken ====
Once a fragment is fully charged, reform Tumeken in the centre and attack Amascut again. She attacks the reformed Tumeken four times: {{RSChat|I AM}} → {{RSChat|THE GOD}} → {{RSChat|OF}} → {{RSChat|DESTRUCTION}}. The player named by Tumeken must intercept. The source is uncertain about the exact multiplier if the attack is missed; it hits the whole team. After four attacks, charge another fragment. Each lightstealer that explodes on Tumeken removes four reform progress.

Amascut dies at zero life points, regardless of reform progress.

== Example kill ==
'''Duo normal-mode talkthrough'''

[[File:Arch-Glacor.png|thumb|220px|The [[Arch-Glacor]] at the [[Glacor Front]].]]
The '''Arch-Glacor''' lets you practise individual mechanics in normal mode. Use this guide to learn the cues, pick a preset, or get through your first hard-mode cannon. For drop rates and the full encounter reference, see [[Arch-Glacor]] and [[Arch-Glacor/Strategies|the wiki strategy guide]].

* '''Learning the fight?''' Start with [[#Normal-mode practice|normal-mode practice]], then turn on one mechanic at a time.
* '''Already comfortable?''' Pick a [[#Presets|preset]] and check the [[#Hard mode|hard-mode changes]].
* '''Dying to the cannon?''' Jump to the [[#Frost Cannon|Frost Cannon counters]].

{{ToC|limit=2}}

== Normal-mode practice ==
Normal mode can be played in a group. Talk to the mages outside the arena to toggle the five mechanics. [[Arch-Glacor/Strategies|Creeping Ice]] still occurs when optional mechanics are off. When the boss can pick multiple specials, the same one can recur at the boundary between cycles.

{| class="wikitable"
! Mechanic !! Who toggles it !! What you are practising
|-
| [[#Flurry|Flurry]] || [[Arianwyn]] || React to ranged and magic cues.
|-
| [[#Glacyte Minions|Glacyte Minions]] || [[Ariane]] || Switch targets and group the minions for area damage.
|-
| [[#Pillars of Ice|Pillars of Ice]] || [[Akthanakos]] || Move between the beams without getting caught.
|-
| [[#Exposed Core|Exposed Core]] || [[Enakhra]] || Focus your damage on one arm.
|-
| [[#Frost Cannon|Frost Cannon]] || [[Charos]] || Recognise the charge and time a defensive.
|}

== Presets ==
These are the original PvME example loadouts, not requirements for entering the fight.
<tabber>
Magic=
* [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=JcJmj9NbUDRmzDhkYOZ1 Open the PvME magic preset.]
* For the minions, the guide uses {{plink|Greater Chain|size=24}} and {{plink|Magma Tempest|size=24}}.
|-|
Melee=
* [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=rPkAfi2w9CZJYxyKK7V0 Open the PvME melee preset.]
* For the minions, the guide uses {{plink|Hurricane|size=24}} and {{plink|Greater Flurry|size=24}}.
|-|
Ranged=
* [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=MhE8Umpw79WhIYuJPIz9 Open the PvME ranged preset.]
* For the minions, the guide uses {{plink|Ricochet|size=24}} and {{plink|Bombardment|size=24}}.
|-|
Necromancy=
* [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=CYtiJmWEAZwOVNam77oN Open the PvME necromancy preset.]
* For the minions, the guide uses {{plink|Spectral Scythe|size=24}} and {{plink|Threads of Fate|size=24}}.
</tabber>
Before bringing a loadout into hard mode, make sure you can activate the defensives you plan to use. If you rely on shield abilities, check your [[Bone Shield]] or shield setup.

== Mechanics ==
=== Auto-attacks ===
Switch between [[Protect from Magic|magic]] and [[Protect from Missiles|ranged]] protection (or the matching [[Ancient Curses|curses]]) as needed. {{plink|Debilitate|size=24}} is an option if damage is getting away from you. [https://img.pvme.io/images/XZgiuE5XNB.mp4 Ranged cue] · [https://img.pvme.io/images/BtHNY8ND13.mp4 Magic cue]

=== Glacyte Minions ===
When the boss summons glacytes, stop attacking it and clear the minions with area abilities. If unstable cores drop, wait until all the minions are dead before shattering the cores. From 250% hard-mode enrage, watch for the bolstered glacyte, except when this is the fight's first mechanic. [https://img.pvme.io/images/kSB6UcI.mp4 PvME demonstration]

=== Flurry ===
Swap protection prayers as the boss changes attack style. Normal mode uses ranged and magic here; hard mode can add melee. {{plink|Resonance|size=24}} or {{plink|Divert|size=24}} can be used on a melee swipe when appropriate. [https://img.pvme.io/images/0CU0qXf.mp4 PvME demonstration]

=== Pillars of Ice ===
Make moving the priority. Use {{plink|Dive|size=24}} or {{plink|Surge|size=24}} to get clear when you have a safe landing tile. Hard mode adds a third beam. [https://img.pvme.io/images/omGXX0a.mp4 PvME safe path]

=== Exposed Core ===
Switch to either arm and break it quickly to escape. Use magic protection if needed while you take increasing damage. [https://img.pvme.io/images/j3d2YIxcr7.mp4 PvME demonstration]

=== Frost Cannon ===
The boss compresses the arena with ice, then pauses to charge its cannon. Pick a response before the charge, especially in hard mode, where the attack hits three times and can stun you.
<tabber>
Normal mode=
* Use {{plink|Resonance|size=24}} to absorb the single hit if available.
* Alternatively, protect against magic and use {{plink|Devotion|size=24}}.
* [https://img.pvme.io/images/20mFMPA.mp4 PvME cannon demonstration]
|-|
Hard mode=
{| class="wikitable"
! Plan !! Sequence
|-
| Devotion ready || {{Ability rotation|Anticipation|Devotion,Deflect Magic}} Anticipate before the hit, then use Devotion with magic protection. [https://img.pvme.io/images/9t9EdxK.mp4 Example]
|-
| Devotion unavailable || {{Ability rotation|Anticipation|Reflect,Deflect Magic|Resonance}} Save Resonance for the last hit. [https://img.pvme.io/images/9PyGvb4.mp4 Example]
|}
If you are stunned, {{plink|Freedom|size=24}} is the recovery option. Do not assume one Resonance will cover all three hits.
</tabber>

=== Visual cues ===
<gallery mode="packed" heights="135">
File:Arch-Glacor Minions Attack.gif|Glacyte Minions|alt=The boss summons glacyte minions.
File:Arch-Glacor Ice Pillars Attack.gif|Pillars of Ice|alt=Ice beams sweep across the arena.
File:Arch-Glacor Exposed Core Attack.gif|Exposed Core|alt=The core opens between the boss's arms.
File:Arch-Glacor Frost Cannon Attack.gif|Frost Cannon|alt=The boss changes shape and charges its cannon.
</gallery>

== Hard mode ==
Hard mode is solo. All five mechanics stay enabled, and life points and mechanics can vary with mode and enrage. Before moving over, practise clearing all five mechanics in normal mode and plan a cannon response when Devotion is on cooldown. See [[Arch-Glacor/Strategies|the wiki strategy guide]] for additional high-enrage responses.

It assumes both players already know the encounter. Use [[The Ghrazi Blood Knights/Strategies|the encounter guide]] for mechanics and telegraphs; this page is the duo setup and rotation, not a solo guide. {| class="wikitable" ! Before you go !! During the kill !! If the timing drifts |- | [[#Positioning|Agree tanks and mark the lure]], then load the [[#Preset|preset]]. || Use [[#War's Retreat|the prebuild]], then [[#Phases 1–3|phases 1–3]], [[#Heart|heart]] or [[#Non-heart|non-heart]], and [[#Phases 4–5|phases 4–5]]. || [[#Return timing|Check heart health and preserve cooldowns]] before restarting the ranged rotation. |} {{ToC|limit=3}} == Positioning == From the instance spawn tile, use {{Ability link|Surge}} and {{Ability link|Dive}} to reach the tile in the [https://img.pvme.io/images/fb16bAODe8.png original positioning diagram]. The lure keeps two tiles between the knights; a diagonal gap also works. {| class="wikitable" ! Tank !! Target cycle !! Positioning note |- | [[Lady Karmina Ghrazi|Karmina]] || Forward || Being moved west or east of Karmina is fine for this setup. |- | [[Lord Vasily Ghrazi|Vasily]] || Backward || Keep using backward target cycle in phases 4–5. |} To mark the lure in-game, import this string using the Tilemarkers [[Plugin|plugin]]: 
TM2ARNHaHJhemkgS25pZ2h0cyBEZWNpAbg_wH0B28_h_6-mtIwCFAEETHVyZQ
== Preset == [https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/a4ac0f53-d82a-4c16-8713-7b7854a872f9/7x4/?v=b7addc6940f0e411a1a8712db1747bd3340981de65e56fde1be827322037857f Open the full PvME preset], including inventory positions and switches. Check !! Preset detail |- | Ammunition || [[Wen arrows]] and [[Black stone arrows]]. Swap where the rotation calls it out. |- | Special attacks || Worn Essence of Finality: [[Eldritch crossbow]]. Carried amulets: [[Decimation]], [[Malachi's tooth]], and [[Gloomfire bow]]. The Bow of the Last Guardian and Dark Shard of Leng specials in the rotation are weapon specials, not amulet calls. |- | Melee switches || Vestments of havoc, [[Dark Shard of Leng]], [[Dark Sliver of Leng]], and a [[Flanking]] switch. Use the original inventory for exact slots. |- | Other preset choices || [[Shadow nihil]], [[Heightened Senses]], [[Desolation]], [[Soul Split]] and [[Vampyrism aspect]]. |} == Rotations == Each arrow separates steps. A plus keeps actions in the same group as written upstream. ''Stall'' and ''release'' are explicit steps from the [https://pvme.io/pvme-guides/editor-resources/editor-references/style-guide/ PvME notation]. '''EoF''' means use the named weapon special through an [[Essence of Finality amulet]], not equip the original weapon. === War's Retreat === '''Wen arrows:''' Greater Ricochet → Greater Death's Swiftness → Imbue Shadows → '''stall''' the Bow of the Last Guardian special with Wen arrows. === Phases 1–3 === # Surge + Dive + '''release''' the Bow of the Last Guardian special + Greater Ricochet → Provoke + Eldritch crossbow EoF → Decimation EoF → Vampyre Slayer + Malachi's tooth EoF. # Gloomfire bow EoF → Deadshot → Gloomfire bow EoF → Gloomfire bow EoF → Gloomfire bow EoF → Greater Ricochet → Gale Shot. === Heart === # Snipe (Flanking) → Shadow Tendrils → Meteor Strike → '''stall''' Adaptive Strike → Berserk → Greater Barge → Overpower → Assault. # Chaos Roar → Hurricane → Backhand (Flanking) → Overpower → Greater Flurry → Dark Shard of Leng special → Punish → Backhand (Flanking). === Non-heart === {{Ability rotation|Meteor Strike|Adaptive Strike|Barricade|Rend}} Do this without moving Karmina, and hit a tumour. # Kill tumours with Piercing Shot → ranged basic → Piercing Shot. # Reapply [[Vulnerability bomb|Vulnerability]] and [[Smoke Cloud]] on '''both''' bosses. '''Cooldown check:''' Greater Ricochet may be used on the second tumour you kill, but not after it. Keep the phases 4–5 abilities available. === Phases 4–5 === # Greater Death's Swiftness + enhanced replenishment potion → Imbue Shadows → Greater Ricochet with '''Wen arrows''' → Decimation EoF → Piercing Shot → Bow of the Last Guardian special with '''Black stone arrows''' → Rapid Fire. # Decimation EoF → Vampyre Slayer + Gloomfire bow EoF with '''Wen arrows''' → Deadshot → Gloomfire bow EoF → Malachi's tooth EoF → Gloomfire bow EoF → Gloomfire bow EoF → Snapshot. ==== Return timing ==== For the player who stays down, use Greater Death's Swiftness and Imbue Shadows when they come off cooldown if the heart has about '''30% health remaining'''; otherwise wait. Karmina's tank keeps forward target cycle, and Vasily's tank keeps backward target cycle. == Example kill == The upstream example shows a '''1:15.6''' duo kill. Use it to check the transition between the heart split and phases 4–5, rather than treating the timer as a target. {{Youtube|BiMMKYNJ7LE}} == Sources and licence == * Adapted from the [https://github.com/pvme/pvme-guides/blob/ee913a530677bddd0af48860062fed8c8efd77a3/rs3-full-boss-guides/ghrazi-blood-knights/gbk-duo-100-ranged-melee.txt PvME duo guide] by PvME contributors, under [https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/ CC BY-NC-SA 4.0]. The rotation matches the earlier Field Guide snapshot; the upstream title now makes the duo scope explicit. * The [https://github.com/pvme/preset-maker-storage/blob/main/presets/a4ac0f53-d82a-4c16-8713-7b7854a872f9.json source preset] supplies the equipment and switches. The wiki version expands shorthand, puts the two roles side by side and retains the original lure image and video. * [[User:Mo rs/PvME|Back to the PvME supplemental guide index]]

[[File:Vorkath.png|thumb|220px|alt=Vorkath, the undead dragon.|Vorkath.]]

This is PvME's '''hard-mode magic/melee hybrid''' for Zemouregal and Vorkath, aiming to skip Vorkath's flight phase. For a mechanic overview, use [[Vorkath/Strategies|the Wiki encounter guide]].

* '''Setting up?''' Open the [[#Preset and relics|equipment and inventory preset]].
* '''Running the kill?''' Jump to [[#Vorkath|Vorkath]], then [[#Zemouregal|Zemouregal]].
* '''Timing off?''' Check the [[#Timing, switches and alternatives|ballista, switch and low-health notes]].
{{ToC|limit=3}}

== Preset and relics ==
=== Starting equipment ===
The worn gear below comes from the original PvME preset data, not an inferred loadout.

{{Equipment
|caption=Starting magic equipment
|helm=Mask of Tumeken's resplendence
|cape=Igneous Kal-Zuk
|neck=Salve amulet (e)
|weap=Fractured Staff of Armadyl
|body=Robe top of Tumeken's resplendence
|legs=Robe bottom of Tumeken's resplendence
|gloves=Gloves of Tumeken's resplendence
|boots=Boots of Tumeken's resplendence
|ring=Reaver's ring
|ammo=Zemouregal's nexus
|pocket=Erethdor's grimoire
}}
{{clear}}

=== Inventory and switches ===
{| class="wikitable"
! Purpose !! Source preset items
|-
| Melee switch || [[Dark Shard of Leng]] and [[Dark Sliver of Leng]], Vestments of havoc, [[Gloves of passage]], and [[Am-hej]].
|-
| Magic weapon switch || [[Roar of Awakening]] and [[Ode to Deceit]].
|-
| Ring and ammunition switches || [[Channeller's ring]], [[Nodon spike harness]], and a [[Grasping rune pouch]].
|-
| Relics and familiar || [[Conservation of Energy]], [[Berserker's Fury]], [[Shadow's Grace]], and a [[Kal'gerion demon]]. The preset's alternate relic is [[Font of Life]] in place of Shadow's Grace.
|}
The example inventory is linked below for exact slots and switches not listed here.

* [https://presets.pvme.io?id=acffac82-93c0-4aaa-9887-1d3945b820d6 Open the original interactive preset].
* [https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2Facffac82-93c0-4aaa-9887-1d3945b820d6.png?alt=media View the original equipment and inventory screenshot]. The screenshot shows '''Conservation of Energy''', '''Berserker's Fury''' and '''Shadow's Grace''' relics, with a '''Kal'gerion demon''' familiar.

== Rotation ==
Each numbered line is the next arrow-separated step. Keep actions joined by '''+''' in the same group. A numbered step does not imply a fixed duration. '''Stall''' and '''release''' expand PvME's notation. '''tc''' means target cycling. An '''Essence of Finality special''' uses the stored special attack, not the original weapon.

=== War's Retreat ===
'''Stall''' the [[Fractured Staff of Armadyl]] [[Weapon Special Attack|special attack]].

=== Vorkath ===
# [[Dive]]
# (tc) '''Release''' the [[Fractured Staff of Armadyl]] special
# [[Greater Sunshine]] + [[Adrenaline renewal potion|adrenaline renewal]]
# [[Greater Concentrated Blast]]
# [[Runic Charge]] + [[Greater Sonic Wave]]
# [[Tsunami]]
# [[Greater Concentrated Blast]]
# [[Channeller's ring]] + [[Asphyxiate]] + [[Undead Slayer (ability)|Undead Slayer ability]]
# Roar of Awakening special
# [[Greater Concentrated Blast]]
# [[Reaver's ring]] + [[Omnipower]]
# [[Wild Magic]]
# [[Smoke Tendrils]]
# [[Dragon battleaxe]] special
# [[Greater Chain]]
# [[Greater Concentrated Blast]]

=== Zemouregal ===
# (Equip [[Vestments of havoc hood]]) [[Meteor Strike]]
# [[Divert]]
# [[Annihilation]] Essence of Finality special
# [[Dismember]]
# [[Adaptive Strike]]
# Out-of-range melee basic attack
# [[Berserk]]
# [[Greater Barge]]
# [[Chaos Roar]]
# '''Stall''' [[Varanus's Mercy]] Essence of Finality special
# '''Release''' [[Varanus's Mercy]] Essence of Finality special + [[Am-hej]] + [[Assault]]
# [[Overpower]]
# [[Varanus's Mercy]] Essence of Finality special + [[Am-hej]]
# [[Punish]]
# [[Assault]]
# [[Overpower]]
# [[Dark Shard of Leng]] special
# [[Flurry]]

== Timing, switches and alternatives ==
[[File:Zemouregal & Vorkath (Arena map with places of power).png|thumb|330px|alt=Map of the Zemouregal and Vorkath arena showing the places of power.|Arena reference from the Wiki encounter guide; it is not a diagram of this rotation.]]

{| class="wikitable"
! Checkpoint !! What to watch
|-
| Ballista || The timing assumes precise Dive, target cycling and Greater Sunshine.
|-
| Vorkath at about 860,000 life points || At Smoke Tendrils, use the Dragon battleaxe special immediately.
|-
| Zemouregal at about 70,000 life points || If using Overpower, move the Granite maul Essence of Finality special up and use them together.
|}

* For Fort Forinthry loading times, try reducing draw distance and turning off textures.
* When diving towards Zemouregal, hover over the northwest part of the minimap so you can Dive quickly. Clicking Zemouregal while doing this is difficult; '''the source marks this interaction as needing investigation'''.
* Ballista timing assumes a precise [[Dive]] → (tc) + [[Greater Sunshine]]. If late, the timing changes.
* Keep [[Am-hej]] equipped and treat [[Varanus's Mercy]] as the Essence of Finality switch. A [[Dragon claw]] special can be used in its place.
* Use the [[Dragon battleaxe]] special immediately if Vorkath is at around '''860,000 life points''' when you use Smoke Tendrils, to build adrenaline sooner for phase 2.
* Keep [[Zemouregal's nexus]] on through Divert, then switch to the [[Nodon spike harness]].
* If Zemouregal has around '''70,000 life points''' at Overpower, move the [[Granite maul]] Essence of Finality special up and use both together.
* For safer kills, replace [[Powerburst of acceleration]] with [[Powerburst of vitality]] and use it after Greater Barge.
* Tectonic is also viable in the source but a couple of seconds slower.
* With '''3+ stacks''' and around '''70,000 life points''', the Dark Shard of Leng special plus Granite maul Essence of Finality special may also work.

== Example kill ==
The source labels this demonstration '''45 kills per hour'''; it is an example, not a promised result.

Source last changed: '''2025-12-03'''; source snapshot: '''12 November 2026''' (checked 15 November 2026). See [[#Source|Source]] for the immutable revision. [[User:Mo rs/PvME/Barrows brothers/Barrows|Next: full guide]] __TOC__ == Introduction == The Barrows Brothers were originally composed of six wights, two more members were added after completing the [[Ritual of the Mahjarrat|Ritual of the Mahjarrat]] and [[Kindred Spirits|Kindred Spirits]] quests. * This guides aims to get you started on doing Barrows runs, and will focus on the original six brothers. ** It will be assumed that you're using Magic and the entry-level preset. * War's Retreat is used for easy access to the Barrows Brothers ** War's Retreat Teleport is unlocked via getting 10 boss kills (any boss). * Using High Contrast Mode lets you see which door is clickable when in the tunnels. ** Right-click the World Map to toggle it on. == Presets and Relics == * [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=Nu2xIB4Lkofr2T9XkjOu Magic - Mid-level] * [https://presets.pvme.io/?id=K7fbsgueiX8Z1w9smbiN Magic - Entry-level] * The mid-level preset and example video can be used as a reference if you're interested in killing Akrisae and Linza. === Useful Unlocks === * The following allow you to increase the efficiency of your runs: ** Although useful, they are '''not''' mandatory. === Items === * [[Salve amulet (e)|Salve amulet (e)]] ** Increases damage and accuracy by 20% when fighting undead monsters. * [[Ghost hunter equipment|Ghost hunter equipment]] ** Increases damage done against ghosts related creatures by 10% when three or more pieces are worn. * [[Powerburst of acceleration#(4)|Powerburst of acceleration]] ** Surge and Dive will increase the speed of your runs. === Other === * [[Luck|Luck enhancers]] ** Increases chances at barrows equipment and amulet of the forsaken ** You only need tier 2 luck. == Mechanics == === The Brothers === * As this is an older encounter, there aren't many mechanics to be wary of. ** Each brother has a mechanic, which can mostly be ignored. ** Dharok increases his damage dealt, the lower his life points get. ** Being underground will periodically drain your prayer points. ** The catacombs are a maze, with a simple puzzle at the end. === The Catacombs === [[File:Barrows maze map.png|thumb|right|300px|Map of the Barrows tunnels.]] * Searching one of the sarcophagi will place you in a random corner of the catacombs. ** This sarcophagus is random, and normally reserved for last. * The catacombs are composed of a series of tunnels, in the shape of a 3x3 grid, with a treasure room in the center. ** The path to the center is randomly generated. ** Using High Contrast Mode makes finding the correct path easier. * The door leading to the center of the catacombs will have one of four, [[The Barrows Brothers/Strategies#The tunnels|simple puzzles]], which always have the same solution. == The Fight == === Order the Brothers Should be Killed === Dharok → Ahrim → Karil → Guthan → Torag → Verac * You can use protection prayers to mitigate damage. ** Protect from Melee on Dharok, Guthan, Torag, and Verac. ** Protect from Magic on Ahrim. ** Protect from Ranged on Karil. * Try to make good use of Surge and Dive == Rotations == * Wild Magic / Asphyxiate → Dragon Breath → Sonic Wave → Tuska's Wrath → improv ** Alternate starts between Wild Magic and Asphyxiate == Example Kills == * [https://youtu.be/x6LXRvWBryM Mid-level] * [https://youtu.be/tvMktwhoIYE Entry-level] == Source == Adapted from
